patch:
diff --git a/src/click/core.py b/src/click/core.py
index 57f549c..86cf06a 100644
--- a/src/click/core.py
+++ b/src/click/core.py
@@ -704,16 +704,32 @@ class Context:
 
         .. versionchanged:: 8.0
             Added the ``call`` parameter.
+
+        .. versionchanged:: 8.2
+            Return ``None`` if no value is found instead of leaking the
+            internal ``UNSET`` sentinel. Use :meth:`_has_default` to
+            distinguish a missing value from an explicit ``None``.
         """
         if self.default_map is not None:
             value = self.default_map.get(name, UNSET)
 
-            if call and callable(value):
-                return value()
+            if value is not UNSET:
+                if call and callable(value):
+                    return value()
 
-            return value
+                return value
+
+        return None
 
-        return UNSET
+    def _has_default(self, name: str) -> bool:
+        """Whether :attr:`default_map` explicitly contains a value for the
+        given name. This tells an explicitly set ``None`` apart from a value
+        that is not set at all, since :meth:`lookup_default` returns ``None``
+        in both cases.
+
+        :meta private:
+        """
+        return self.default_map is not None and name in self.default_map
 
     def fail(self, message: str) -> t.NoReturn:
         """Aborts the execution of the program with a specific error
@@ -2280,7 +2296,10 @@ class Parameter:
         """
         value = ctx.lookup_default(self.name, call=False)  # type: ignore
 
-        if value is UNSET:
+        # ``lookup_default`` returns ``None`` for unset values, but an
+        # explicitly configured ``None`` must be kept, and a subclass may
+        # still return the internal sentinel.
+        if value is UNSET or (value is None and not ctx._has_default(self.name)):
             value = self.default
 
         if call and callable(value):
@@ -2322,7 +2341,13 @@ class Parameter:
 
         if value is UNSET:
             default_map_value = ctx.lookup_default(self.name)  # type: ignore
-            if default_map_value is not UNSET:
+
+            # ``None`` from the default map is either an explicit value or
+            # the "not set" result of ``lookup_default``.
+            if default_map_value is not UNSET and (
+                default_map_value is not None
+                or ctx._has_default(self.name)
+            ):
                 value = default_map_value
                 source = ParameterSource.DEFAULT_MAP
